title: Correct U_PM calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates U_PM = +20 V using the definition U = W/q with the electron's charge.

title: Correct U_MN calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates U_MN = -30 V, accounting for the work done by the field and the electron's charge.

title: Correct φ_P with φ_M=0
description: Essential: Student correctly states φ_P = +20 V, applying the relationship φ_P - φ_M = U_PM with φ_M = 0.

title: Correct E_P calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates the electron's potential energy at P as E_P = -20 eV using E = qφ.

title: Sign handling for work
description: Important: Student's reasoning demonstrates correct sign interpretation for work done 'overcoming' the field vs. work done 'by' the field.

title: Definition of potential difference
description: Important: Student applies the definition U_AB = W_AB / q, where W_AB is work done by an external agent moving charge q from A to B.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Student's final answers include correct units (V and eV) and shows unit analysis in steps.

title: Sign error in U_MN
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns a positive sign to U_MN, forgetting that work done by the field on the electron implies a negative potential difference.

title: Confusing potential and energy
description: Pitfall: Student confuses electric potential (φ) with electric potential energy (E), e.g., stating E_P = +20 eV.
